text: 摩根大通朱锋：实现全年增长目标，关键在于财政政策执行提速 他认为二季度财政支出节奏偏慢，财政存款相对充裕。这意味着下半年财政资金调度和债券发行仍有进一步提速的空间
text_en: JP Morgan's Zhu Feng: Achieving Full-Year Growth Target Depends on Faster Fiscal Policy Implementation; He Notes Q2 Fiscal Spending Pace Was Slower, and Fiscal Deposits Remain Relatively Ample, Indicating Room for Further Acceleration in Fiscal Fund Allocation and Bond Issuance in H2
